source.title: Where's your built game?
source.description: Point Packmaster at the folder your bundler already built — the output of your own build step, not your source code. If your game was built with Vite.js, that's the {{dist}} folder Vite creates when you run {{command}} (usually right next to your {{packageJson}}).
source.browseDialogTitle: Select your game's build output folder
source.errorTitle: This doesn't look like a build output folder
source.errorDescription: Packmaster couldn't find an {{indexHtml}} in this folder. Double-check you picked the built output (e.g. {{dist}}), not your project's source folder.
source.errorLooksLikeSource: This folder still has a {{packageJson}} in it — that means it's your project's source folder, not its built output. Run your build first, then pick the {{dist}} folder it creates.

releaseInfo.title: Release info
releaseInfo.description: Used to name the files Packmaster generates.
releaseInfo.versionFromPackageJson: Taken from your project's package.json — edit it there to change it.

portable.title: Portable
portable.description: A single double-click-to-run bundle for each platform you pick — no installer, no admin rights needed.
portable.shellUnavailable: No published shell build found for: {{platforms}} — try again later.

installers.title: Installable packages
installers.description: A proper installer for each platform you enable. Turning one on lets you also pick which installer format to build.
installers.unavailableOnThisSystem: Building this requires {{system}}, which isn't available on your current system.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Optional integrations, compiled in only if you enable them.
plugins.steamDescription: Achievements, stats, DLC, overlay, and store, via Steamworks. Degrades harmlessly if Steam isn't running or wasn't enabled.

compression.title: Content compression
compression.description: Packs your game's content into a handful of compressed archives instead of shipping it as loose, individually browsable files. Extracted automatically the first time your game runs.
compression.levelDescription: Lower favors faster startup extraction; higher favors a smaller download.
compression.maxPackSizeDescription: Splits archives so none exceeds this size.
compression.excludeDescription: Glob patterns, one per line — useful for a save-data or user-config folder that needs to stay as plain, writable files.
compression.bootIncludeDescription: Glob patterns, one per line, for extra files needed as soon as your game starts (beyond your HTML file and whatever it directly references).

generating.title: Generating your release…
generating.doneDescription: Packmaster saved everything to the {{folder}} folder.
generating.errorGeneric: Packmaster couldn't finish generating your release.

shellUpdate.title: A new shell version is available
shellUpdate.description: Packmaster currently targets Roves shell {{current}}, but {{latest}} has been published.
